answer: The nebula I would price into every new account is Canal lock keeper appointment with waterways authority attestation: each appointment is a named keeper responsible for a flight of locks, so a farm must staff a hundred real canals, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the ocean for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The harbor is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
